figXY.cap: (a) The set $|\operatorname{Im} z| < \pi/2$, the line $\operatorname{Im}z=0.8$, and the point $z_0=0$ in the $z$-plane. (b) Their images under $F$, where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\frac{e^{z}-1}{e^{z}+1}. \]\fi Regions are shaded by a checkerboard of squares of side $1$ in the $z$-plane, carried by the map.

figDef.cap: The deformation $H_t$ from the identity ($t=0$) to $F$ ($t=2$), at (a) $t=0$, (b) $t=2/3$, (c) $t=4/3$, and (d) $t=2$, where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\frac{e^{z}-1}{e^{z}+1}. \]\fi Solid: the paths $t\mapsto H_t(z)$ of the marked points up to the frame's $t$; dotted: the rest of each path; gray: the boundary at $t=0$.

figPhase.cap: Phase portrait of $F$ on $[-6,6]\times[-4,4]$, where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\frac{e^{z}-1}{e^{z}+1}. \]\fi The color shows $\arg F$ (key at right), the thin lines are the level sets $\arg F\in\frac{\pi}{6}\mathbb{Z}$, and the shading steps in $|F|$ by factors of $e^{2\pi/12}\approx 1.69$; the white line is $|F|=1$. Zeros (dots) at $0$. Poles (open circles) at $\pi i$ and $-\pi i$.

figLand.cap: Landscape of $F$ over $[-8,8]\times[-6,6]$, where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\frac{e^{z}-1}{e^{z}+1}. \]\fi The height is $\log|F|$ and the color shows $\arg F$; zeros are pits and poles are peaks.

figLandDef.cap: Landscapes of $H_t$ over $[-8,8]\times[-6,6]$ at (a) $t=0$, (b) $t=2/3$, (c) $t=4/3$, and (d) $t=2$: the height is $\log|H_t|$ and the color shows $\arg H_t$; zeros are pits and poles are peaks. Here $H_t$, $0\le t\le 2$, deforms the identity ($t=0$) into $F$ ($t=2$) and runs the steps in turn ($H_t=H^{(k)}_{t-k+1}$ on $k-1\le t\le k$): for $f_{1}$, the zoom homotopy ${H^{(1)}_{s}}(z)=(e^{sz}-1)/s+s$ for $0<s\le 1$, ${H^{(1)}_{0}}(z)=z$; for $f_{2}$, the elliptic M\"obius transformations ${H^{(2)}_{s}}$ that fix $p=i$ and $q=-i$, with ${H^{(2)}_{s}}'(p)=e^{-\pi i s/2}$, where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \begin{gathered}\displaystyle F(z)=\frac{e^{z}-1}{e^{z}+1},\qquad F=f_{2}\circ f_{1},\\ \displaystyle f_{1}(z)=e^{z},\qquad f_{2}(w_{1})=\frac{w_{1}-1}{w_{1}+1}.\end{gathered} \]\fi

figPhaseDef.cap: Phase portraits of $H_t$ on $[-6,6]\times[-4,4]$ at (a) $t=0$, (b) $t=2/3$, (c) $t=4/3$, and (d) $t=2$: the color shows $\arg H_t$ (key at right), the thin lines are the level sets $\arg H_t\in\frac{\pi}{6}\mathbb{Z}$, and the shading steps in $|H_t|$ by factors of $e^{2\pi/12}\approx 1.69$; the white line is $|H_t|=1$. Zeros are dots and poles are open circles. Here $H_t$, $0\le t\le 2$, deforms the identity ($t=0$) into $F$ ($t=2$) and runs the steps in turn ($H_t=H^{(k)}_{t-k+1}$ on $k-1\le t\le k$): for $f_{1}$, the zoom homotopy ${H^{(1)}_{s}}(z)=(e^{sz}-1)/s+s$ for $0<s\le 1$, ${H^{(1)}_{0}}(z)=z$; for $f_{2}$, the elliptic M\"obius transformations ${H^{(2)}_{s}}$ that fix $p=i$ and $q=-i$, with ${H^{(2)}_{s}}'(p)=e^{-\pi i s/2}$, where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \begin{gathered}\displaystyle F(z)=\frac{e^{z}-1}{e^{z}+1},\qquad F=f_{2}\circ f_{1},\\ \displaystyle f_{1}(z)=e^{z},\qquad f_{2}(w_{1})=\frac{w_{1}-1}{w_{1}+1}.\end{gathered} \]\fi

figGlobeDef.cap: The deformation $H_t$ on the Riemann sphere, with $\infty$ at the north pole, from the identity ($t=0$) to $F$ ($t=2$), where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\frac{e^{z}-1}{e^{z}+1}. \]\fi At (a) $t=0$, (b) $t=2/3$, (c) $t=4/3$, and (d) $t=2$, the frames show the image of the set $|\operatorname{Im} z| < \pi/2$, the line $\operatorname{Im}z=0.8$, and the point $z_0=0$ under $H_t$. Solid: the path $t\mapsto H_t(z)$ of the point $0.8i$ (dot) up to the frame's $t$; dotted: the rest of the path; gray: the boundary at $t=0$. The square is the image of the point $z_0=0$; in (a) and (d) it is on the far side of the sphere.

figDeriv.cap: The deformation $H_t$: the image of the disc $|z|\le 1.6$ and a polar grid in $|z|\le 1.6$ under $H_t$. Shown at $t=0.50$. Here $H_t$, $0\le t\le 2$, deforms the identity ($t=0$) into $F$ ($t=2$) and runs the steps in turn ($H_t=H^{(k)}_{t-k+1}$ on $k-1\le t\le k$), where\ifinner\hskip\hsize\else\[ \displaystyle F(z)=\frac{d}{dz}\left(z^{3}-3\,z\right). \]\fi For $f_{1}$, the zoom homotopy ${H^{(1)}_{s}}(z)=(1-s)p_{1}+sf_{1}(p_{1})+f_{1}'(p_{1})^{s-1}\bigl(f_{1}(p_{1}+s(z-p_{1}))-f_{1}(p_{1})\bigr)/s$ about $p_{1}=1.732$ (principal power): the critical points of $f_{1}$ fly in from infinity along the rays from $p_{1}$; for $f_{2}$, the straight-line homotopy ${H^{(2)}_{s}}(w_{1})=(1-s)w_{1}+s\,f_{2}(w_{1})$.
